decision_scope: service diagnostic only; no scientific evidence, hypothesis, plan, scoring seed, candidate, benchmark, schema or scoring
prohibited_shortcuts: WT test files 8 and 9 or any three-family test target
family labels, native types, paths, semantic channel names, mask/native-width routing or supplied adjacency
post-diagnostic changes to features, ridge, edge selection, random seed or thresholds

wt_development_diagnostic.examples: teacher-forced transitions from the last history row through the first 32 target rows of every episode; the scalar public control is constant within an episode
wt_development_diagnostic.normalization: existing fit-only WT normalization and one fixed anonymous channel permutation from PCG64 seed 130031

controls.dense_var: intercept, public control and all ten current coordinates
controls.sparse_var: per output: intercept, public control, self and the one other linear parent selected by absolute fit residual correlation
controls.static_tree: per output: intercept, public control, self and neighbors in a fit-only maximum-absolute-correlation spanning tree
controls.random_graph: same sparse linear form with one other parent drawn per output from PCG64 seed 130032

wt_development_diagnostic.tested_local_rule: per output, start from self plus public control; select on fit only one other parent and one of x_parent, square(x_parent), x_self*x_parent or tanh(x_parent) by absolute residual correlation; refit that local ridge rule without changing the basis on development
wt_development_diagnostic.permutation_equivariance: repeat after a second consistent channel permutation; inverse-mapped selected edges and predictions must agree within 1e-9
wt_development_diagnostic.edge_stability: repeat selection independently on fit files 0-2 and 3-5; compare exact output-parent-basis triples

contract_gates.mandatory_distinction: a future learner must beat the frozen nonlinear local-basis diagnostic as well as dense/sparse VAR, static-tree, random-graph, persistence, RLS and transition controls; graph discovery alone is not a distinct principle

overall_pass_rule: all WT numerical gates pass and the same causal discriminator is expressible without mask routing in the three-family contract; otherwise create no hypothesis and keep HYP-0006 dormant

outcomes.pass: a later wake may create one low-confidence hypothesis before implementation or scoring
outcomes.fail: record no_distinct_sparse_local_rule_contract and create no hypothesis, candidate, plan, benchmark or schema
